scope: Fix keybind persistence: ui_open_inventory (Show Inventory) and ui_open_menu (Show Menu) are missing from Keybindings.configurable_actions, so GameState.load_keybinds() never replays their saved keybind_overrides after restart and the game falls back to defaults (I/Tab, C/ESC). Adding both actions to configurable_actions makes load_keybinds() replay the stored override for them while preserving the default keys when no override exists.

entities.expected_runtime_effect: GameState.load_keybinds() (called unconditionally from load_game() local branch and from _on_load()/reset_game_state()) will now iterate ui_open_inventory and ui_open_menu as well: when a keybind override exists in saved_stats.keybind_overrides it erases the default InputMap key events and adds the stored physical_scancode (custom key persists after restart); when no override exists it snapshots the first InputMap key event into keybind_overrides without touching InputMap, so the defaults I/Tab (ui_open_inventory) and C/ESC (ui_open_menu) remain effective.
